links.outcome: Expert-rated demographic bias and demographic diversity in GPT-4-generated dermatology vignettes
links.effect: Experts rated demographic bias low (1.52/5), but vignettes lacked significant demographic diversity.
links.quote: Vignettes did not incorporate significant demographic diversity.

unlisted_practices: Using LLMs to generate synthetic medical education content (clinical vignettes) with expert physician review

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of GPT-4 generated dermatology clinical vignettes for medical education, evaluated by physician experts for accuracy, quality, harm, and demographic bias.
